statistics.primary: A1/A2/A3 minus A0 global random25 RMSE_V; positive = worse
statistics.aggregation: paired seed effects averaged within subject, then unweighted mean over 9 subjects
statistics.primary_multiplicity: 3 two-sided exact sign-flip tests; Holm familywise 0.05
statistics.confidence_intervals: paired subject bootstrap 20000 draws seed9173; 95% percentile plus Bonferroni family-size3 intervals
statistics.regional: outside14 relative RMSE change minus inside8 relative change, random25 only; exploratory separate Holm family of3
statistics.outside14_and_controls: descriptive; not additional uncorrected confirmatory tests
statistics.missing_runs: no complete-case inference; report missing, retry same fixed seed or state incomplete
